Penglai Immortal

In the legendary paradise of Penglai, a girl's immortality journey takes a turn due to your arrival...

GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
Event Rules

◆ During the Penglai Immortal event, explore and challenge with guildmates.

◆ Goal: Explore higher levels and discover treasures!

Exploring Penglai

◆ Each exploration consumes stamina. Progress sharing by guildmates.

◆ Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 20 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. Use Immortal's Buns or a basket of them to restore.

◆ Earn exploration points by exploring areas and find Herb Spirits, lost items, Cranes, cave entrances, Treasure Gourds or other guildmates.

◆ Earn exploration points to claim rewards in Achievements and the Penglai Battle Pass.

Deeper Exploration

◆ After finding all Cranes on current level, all guildmates can advance to next level.

◆ Note: Advancing to next levels locks previous ones, but Treasure Caves remain accessible via Guild Bulletin Board.

◆ Penglai has 5 areas: Village, Market, Ferry Crossing, Blossom Haven, and Immortal Mountain. Each has 5 levels (25 total).

◆ Achievement points remain consistent per area, but Herb Spirits' HP and rewards increase with level progress.

◆ Rumor has it that beyond Immortal Mountain's peak lies mysterious Endless Level for challenges.

Subduing Herb Spirits

◆ Your power is determined by the total power of fellows, boosted by guild ship, character bonuses and Battle Pass privilege.

◆ Subdue the various Herb Spirits spotted during exploration for rewards.

◆ You can invite guildmates for joint attacks before subduing. The damage is determined by powers of total participants.

Crane Search

◆ Each island contains one Crane. Find all Cranes to advance to the next level.

◆ Cranes hide near distinctive markers. Clues will emerge upon island entry - follow them!

Treasure Cave

◆ Accessible via cave entrances. Contains multiple chests (1 claim per guildmate).

◆ Starting from Level 3, there's a chance to uncover a cave entrance when exploring. Chances are affected by progress on this level.

◆ Gain 2 extra claims in current level's Treasure Cave.

◆ There are 5 super chests on each level's Treasure Cave - let's see who's the lucky guildmate.

Treasure Gourd & Celestial Gourd

◆ Treasure Gourds may be spotted during exploration. Activate to instantly explore cross-shaped area.

◆ Explore beyond areas of Treasure Gourd with Celestial Gourds (obtainable via Battle Pass or Chubby Ginger Store).

Other guildmates

◆ Starting from Level 6, you may encounter mates from other guilds during exploration.

◆ Consider friendly duel if met - no losses will incur.

◆ Each encounter features 5 mates. Victory count determines rewards.

Lost Cargo

◆ Clumsy Chubby Ginger lost some goods in Penglai. Help to retrieve during exploration.

◆ Recovered goods will be sold at a discount for all guildmates.

Ginseng Spirit

◆ Ginseng Spirit emerges daily at 12:00 and leaves at 22:00. All transcenders can attempt to subdue.

◆ You will earn generous reward for your guild upon subduing.

◆ Once subdued, the Ginseng Spirit will regroup (immune from subdue again), but attack damages will be logged.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ Penglai Immortal ranks are divided into Total Ranking and Daily Ranking.

◆ Daily rankings (settle daily) are based on individual/guild damage to Ginseng Spirit.

◆ Total Rankings (settle at the end of the event) are based on personal stamina consumption and guild exploration level. (Tiebreaker: exploration progress).

◆ After the ranks are calculated, rewards can be claimed accordingly.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be sent to you via mail.
